drafts.text:
Most companies don't need more AI tools. They need people trained to use the ones they already have.

Last Tuesday in Cincinnati, 42 small business owners showed us what that looks like. Most had never opened an AI tool before. By noon, a bakery owner had automated her catering inquiries. She didn't buy new software. She spent one morning in a free, hands-on workshop learning to use what was already in front of her.

Training comes before tools. People do the work, and AI helps them do more of it.

Our next workshop is on [date] at [venue]. Bring a task you'd like help with.

What's one tool your team already has but barely uses? Agree or disagree that training matters more than new tools?

Try it this week and tell us in the comments: what did you change?

#SmallBusiness #Cincinnati
